$comment: Machine-readable companion to SECURITY-AUDIT-ALLOWLIST.md section 1. Every entry here MUST have a
matching, justified subsection in that register — the register is the reviewed evidence (TF-13),
this file is only what the CI gate reads. Consumed by scripts/audit-frontend-prod.mjs.
Policy (see the register): suppress only what genuinely cannot be fixed, scope the justification to
why the device is not exposed, name an owner, and record a flip/review date. Anything with an
available non-breaking fix is fixed, not suppressed.
reviewBy is enforced: once it passes, the gate fails until the entry is re-justified or removed.
A suppression must never quietly become permanent.

allow.summary: RSC Mode CSRF bypass allows action execution before 400 response
allow.reason: Not exposed: the vulnerable path is react-router's RSC / framework server mode. CoGA ships a Vite SPA that mounts a plain <BrowserRouter> in frontend/src/index.tsx and has no @react-router/dev, no react-router.config, and no RSC server entry, so no request ever reaches the affected handler.
allow.noFixAvailable: Patched only in react-router 8.3.0 (major). `npm audit fix --force` resolves downward to 7.11.0, also a breaking change. No non-breaking fix exists for the 7.x line.
allow.flipAction: Remove this entry as part of the react-router v7 -> v8 migration.
